prompts.cta: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: transparent PNG sprite for a Chinese casual match-three mobile game UI. Art direction: premium playful sticker illustration, chunky glossy 2.5D toy rendering, warm dark-brown ink contours, thick warm-white die-cut outer silhouette, lively asymmetrical composition, big readable shapes, candy highlights and soft colored contact shadows. Feels like the richly illustrated event buttons in Catch Big Goose, NOT a plain app icon, NOT a generic rounded rectangle, NOT photorealistic. True alpha outside sticker, no checkerboard painted in, no backdrop, no watermark. Front view UI composition. Create ONE wide horizontal main play button, 1536x512 canvas, aspect 3:1. A large puffed bright cyan/sky-blue jelly plaque with a dark blue thick lower lip, warm-white thick outer sticker rim and brown outline. The outer silhouette is gently irregular, inflated ends. Tiny embossed bubbles, bone and paw motifs INSIDE blue face near edges, clean clear central 55% RESERVED FOR TEXT LATER. NO TEXT OR LETTERS. On the far left a small orange Shiba head peeks cheerfully over the rim, far right a yellow star and small orange paw. Very readable blue center. Keep all decorations within canvas with 4% transparent padding, no giant glow. This entire decorative sprite will retain its aspect ratio in Unity; it will never be anisotropically stretched.
